items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_comp
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (k l : ℕ) : Polynomial.hasseDeriv k ∘ₗ Polynomial.hasseDeriv l = (k + l).choose k • Polynomial.hasseDeriv (k + l)

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_comp
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] (k l : ℕ) (f : LaurentSeries V) : (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R l) f) = (k + l).choose k • (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R (k + l)) f

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_comp_coeff
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] (k l : ℕ) (f : LaurentSeries V) (n : ℤ) : ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R k) ((LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R l) f)).coeff n = ((k + l).choose k • (LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R (k + l)) f).coeff n
